notes:
Quick CRM summary (raw notes):
- Company: Archipelago Product AI — analytics platform embedded in customer product; mid-market (200–600 eng/users).
- Primary ask: reduce customer support ticket deflection time + surface better search results in product recommendations.
- Started with Redwood hosted API for fast proof, now leaning Dedicated for predictable throughput and data separation.
- Tech contacts: Marta G. (Engineering Lead), Omar S. (Infra), Lina (Product PM). Business sponsor: VP Product — Claire Huang.
- Demo feedback: output quality good; worst pain = per-token cost on high-volume rerank jobs.
- Cost workshop notes:
  * Ran unit-economics model for support-agent: baseline hosted = $0.018/token-equivalent; suggested configs reduce to estimated $0.006–0.009 via batching + prefix caching + 8-bit quantization for rerank model.
  * Suggested batching: dynamic batching window 20ms, target batch sizes ~64 for rerank jobs during peak. Expected throughput uplift x3 without harming median latency.
  * KV / prefix caching: canonical customer dialogues cache improved token reuse by ~28% in sample traces. Use Redis-backed prefix cache in Dedicated.
  * Quantization profiles: one conservative profile (mixed int8 + fp16 kv) and one aggressive int8-only. Recommended conservative for initial POC.
  * Fallback routing: keep hosted as overflow policy during Dedicated maintenance windows.
- Procurement: asked for 6–12 month reserved capacity options and an optional burst lane. Finance prefers quarterly invoicing; legal requests retention and residency clauses.
- Quote/asks: initial dedicated estimate in drive deck; will need a smaller starter reserve to prove ROI then scale.
- Marta: "If we can get 40% unit-cost reduction with <2% accuracy delta we can justify moving to Dedicated."
- Next steps: finalize Dedicated pricing worksheet, attach legal redline to SOW, set up POC telemetry dashboard, schedule capacity run on 2026-03-21.
use_case_summary: Primary workloads: conversational support assistant (low-latency), reranking for in-product search (high-throughput), embeddings for semantic matching. Latency targets: median <200ms token latency for chat flow, tail p95 <600ms. Throughput: batch rerank jobs up to 12k requests/hour; embeddings refresh nightly for 2M docs. Cost sensitivity: high — team wants clear unit economics and staged path from hosted->dedicated.
commercial_notes: Finance prefers 6–12 month committed reserved pool. Interested in break/fix SLAs and optional extended observability add-on for token-level cost reporting. Requested sample invoice and T&Cs adjusted for data residency.
